notes.title: Community Challenge Update - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello, Survivors! Today, we are releasing the free Community Challenge update which features new community challenges, mutators, rewards, portrait frames, and more! New challenges are awaiting you... prove your skills and fight against the undead now!

If you encounter any issues, make sure to submit a ticket to the support team: https://support.saber.games.


Check out the launch trailer and read the full details below!

[previewyoutube=N47DcESOFt0;full][/previewyoutube]


[b][h1]New Content[/h1][/b]
[list][*][b]Reworked Extinction Mode:[/b]
- The mode is now unlocked after completing any map on the Insane difficulty or higher.
- The mode now includes two Episodes to choose from and the reward is given for fully completing one of them.
- The weapon skin reward will now change every week together with the Episodes.
[*][b]Added Community Challenges:[/b] Time-limited challenges with a shared goal for all players.
[*][b]Added the Royal Vengeance Heavy Weapons Skin Pack:[/b] Skin rewards for the Machine Gun MAG5, Payload Rifle BF25, and Heavy Assault Shotgun Taiga-12 for completing the Community Challenges.
[*][b]Added the Knight Heavy Weapons Skin Pack:[/b] Skin rewards for the MGL Hailstorm MGL, RPG Launcher RPGL4, and Heavy Assault Shotgun Taiga-12 for completing Extinction Mode.
[*][b]Added four new custom portrait frames:[/b] Red Light, Memento Mori, To the Top, and Virologist.
[*][b]Added seven new mutators:[/b] Hot Stuff, Сluster Shells, Doppelganger, Fire-resistant, Acid Spit, Effective Defense, and Overprice.
[*][b]Reworked three mutators:[/b] Epilogue, Sell-out, and Taxes.
[/list]
[b][h1]Resolved Issues [/h1][/b]
[list][*]Fixed several connection issues with starting full-party sessions.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player would not receive Blue Coins in Extinction Mode if the skin reward was already obtained.
[*]Removed the white stripe from under the minimap.
[*]Fixed an issue with incorrect skin icons for the MAG5.
[*]Fixed an issue with unlocking the "Waster" portrait frame.
[*]Fixed localization for Defensive SMG "G-Force" perk in Japanese.
[*]Fixed localization for Classic Bullpup Rifle "Scorpion Sting" and "Adrenaline" perks in Japanese.
[/list]

notes.title: Sin City Apocalypse Update - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello, Survivors! Today, we are releasing the new Sin City Apocalypse update, which brings a new “Vegas” premium story campaign episode, four new survivors, the new premium “Vegas Skin Pack” DLC, and free content including the WASP-180 Defensive SMG weapon and a new Bells trinket.

Join the ultimate gamble of survival and make your own luck against the Zekes in fabulous Las Vegas! It’s the perfect time to get the party started, as WWZ is also celebrating over 25 million players worldwide!

If you experience any issues, make sure to submit a ticket to the support team: https://support.saber.games/


Check out the launch trailer and read the full details about the update below!
>> [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CIUymUWih7c]Watch the Launch Trailer Here[/url] <<

- New “Las Vegas” story episode with three new missions.

[*]Added new “Las Vegas” skin pack, featuring:
- New outfit skin for survivor Sara Benedict.
- Four new weapon skins, one each for the 1911 Protector Pistol, PAC-15 Sporting Carbine, WASP-180 Defensive SMG, and 1877 SBL Repeating Rifle.
[*]Added a new weapon: Defensive SMG WASP-180.
[*]Added a new Bells trinket.
[*]Added new customizable portrait frames.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the Dronemaster perk "Parting Gift" where it did not grant temporary health.
[*]Fixed an issue in which the Myopia mutator had no effect.

notes.title: Extinction Update - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello, survivors! Today, we are releasing a new update that features 13 fresh mutators for Challenge Horde Mode, the addition of the Arizona XL map to Challenge Horde Mode, a new heavy weapon skin customization option, the premium Golden Bloom Weapon Skin Pack DLC, and the new - exceptionally tough - Extinction Challenge Mode! Will you be able to endure it?

If you encounter any issues, please submit a ticket to the support team: https://support.saber.games/.


Check out the launch trailer and read the full details below!

[previewyoutube=zHBNN5Cfiz4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1][b]New Content[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]New Challenge Mode - Extinction.
[*]New heavy weapon skins as rewards for completing Extinction Mode.
[*]New Golden Bloom Weapon Skin Pack DLC, containing five gold floral patterns for the Geist 17MP pistol, Paladin LMG rifle, Keris V10 SMG, BSS-2 shotgun, and MAG-5 machine gun.
[*]Added the Arizona map to the Horde Mode XL Challenge Mode.
[*]Added 13 new mutators for Challenge Horde Mode, including:
- [b]Grenadier:[/b] The Bomber throws explosives until neutralized.
- [b]Myopia:[/b] After aiming, your vision becomes blurred.
- [b]Plague creatures:[/b] During the wave, a random special zombie and poison cloud appears.
- [b]Mass contamination:[/b] The Booster infects a larger group of zombies nearby.
- [b]Angry turrets:[/b] At the start of the wave, all deployed turrets become neutral, posing a deadly threat to both zombies and human players.
- [b]New advantages for all 8 Classes:[/b] Raise the health and damage of each class by 50%.
[/list]
[h1][b]Resolved Issues[/b][/h1] 
[list]
[*]Fixed unlocking issues with the Iron Man portrait frame.
[*]Fixed an issue in which some prestige perks did not work immediately after unlocking.
[*]Fixed an issue in which the menu items in collections were unclickable.
[*]Fixed an issue that resulted in players not seeing allied players’ messages in the PvP text chat.
[*]Fixed an issue where a player could remain in the current party when accepting an invite to another party.
[*]Fixed an issue with changing resolution when switching to Borderless Mode.
[*]Fixed an issue in which aim-assist no longer works on lying, sleeping zombies.
[/list]

notes.title: Extinction Update Launch Day 💥💀
notes.content:
Get ready to push your survival skills to the limit like never before! 🪓😏

The new Extinction Challenge Mode will raise the difficulty bar even higher. Featuring more aggressive zombies that are harder to take down, they can infect you on contact, allies that will be tougher to distinguish from the pack, and death that will occur after just one incapacitation... plus, respawns will only be possible at checkpoints! 😵

Do you think you've got the guts to face it? We'll see about that on September 24! 👀

notes.content:
Hello, survivors! Today, we launched the Battle of Arizona update, introducing a brand-new map for the massive Horde Mode XL, set in an abandoned military museum in Phoenix, AZ, a new Desert Defenders Weapons Pack, some new free features, and game fixes.

If you encounter any issues, please send a ticket to the support team: https://support.saber.games/.


You can check out the launch trailer and read the full details below!

[previewyoutube=2yjRFIw9Bss;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1][b]New Content[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new map: Horde Mode XL Arizona.
[*]Added the Desert Defenders Weapons Skin Pack DLC which contains:
- The new Kukri melee weapon.
- Four new weapon skins for the DE50 pistol, 1877 SBL rifle, TMP5 SMG, and M500 shotgun.
[*]Added new pickups: Improving Bags.
[*]Added customizable portrait frames.
[*]Added the ability to change classes while playing in Horde Mode, Horde Mode XL, and Horde Mode Challenge.
[/list]
[h1][b]General[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the unlock notification markers of new prestige perks in the menu.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Dronemaster "It's Alive" perk, where it wasn't working on higher difficulties.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Medic's Hypervitaminosis perk that was causing incorrect health gain and was not working properly.
[*]Fixed an issue with not getting temporary health from various sources due to mutators that reduced basic health to a minimum.
[*]Fixed an issue so that the Anthrax and Cannon Fodder mutators can no longer be encountered at the same time.
[*]Fixed the localization for mutator Sinusitis.
[*]Fixed the localization for mutator Anthrax.
[/list]

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=r9kH5xQR-S8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Valley of the Zeke is live now on console and PC![/h3]

🌵 Introducing Phoenix, a brand new premium episode set in Arizona! Grab your gear and protect the convoy!

Valley of the Zeke also features:

🧍 4 new playable characters!

👕 New premium character skins!

🔫 New secondary weapon: DE50 Heavy Pistol!

🪖 New special zombie: Juggernaut!

🎖️ New military zombies!

☢️ 7 new Challenge Horde mode mutators!

🔧 New premium weapon skins!


[h3]New Content:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Valley of the Zeke Episode DLC
[*]New Playable Characters
[*]Pre-Apocalypse Character Skins Pack DLC
[*]Burning Skulls Weapons Skin Pack DLC
[*]New Weapon - DE50 Heavy Pistol
[*]New Special Zombie - Juggernaut
[*]Added Challenge Mode for Rome XL
[*]Added Japanese language for PC versions (Steam, EGS, and Microsoft Store)
[*]New Mutators for Challenge Mode:
[list]
[*]Wild West - everyone gets a free Lever-Action Rifle (primary weapon) and a Revolver (secondary weapon) and can't have any other weapon.
[*]Matador - dodging Bull charges will reward players with resources; however, if caught, the resources will get lost.
[*]Epilogue - deadly gas for zombies will be released during the attack on the final gate (once per match).
[*]Neural Network - all auto-turrets will be equipped with explosive rounds, but their operational time will be reduced by 1 (from 3).
[*]Homeopathy - using medical items will disable sprinting for 20 seconds.
[*]Protect Me - if the marked player dies, the former player will lose resources.
[*]Expired Medicine - the more damage you take, the more medkits you will find, but their healing effect will be reduced by 50%.[/list]
[/list]

You can find the patch notes [url=https://support.saber.games/hc/en-us/articles/20603699235985-December-5-2023-Patch-Notes]here[/url].

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_DAMuYzHp20;full][/previewyoutube]

🕇 The “Holy Terror” Update is live now on console and PC!

⛪ Introducing a new Horde Mode XL map, Rome! Grab your defenses, bank those points, and prepare to face down a massive horde of Zekes! 


“Holy Terror” also features:

🗐 9 New perks for classes!

☢️ 12 New mutators for Challenge Horde mode!

🔫 2 New weapons!

🔧 New premium weapon skins!

🎁 Free trinkets!


[h1]New Content[/h1]

[list]
[*] New Paid DLC - Victory Lap Weapon Skins Pack.
[*] New Horde Mode XL Map - Rome.
[*] New primary weapon - Repeating Rifle.
[*] New heavy weapon - Multi-Shot Rocket Launcher.
[*] New perks for specific weapons.
[*] 4 New trinkets for characters.
[*] 9 New perks for each player class.
[*] 12 New Mutators in Horde Mode Challenge:

[list]
[*] Airstrike (the mortar shell can land in three random locations).
[*]  Healing Explosions (device and heavy weapon explosions restore health).
[*] Drone Army (each player receives a temporary drone).
[*] Free Meds (free medicine becomes available in the main shop).
[*] The Pursuers (players can encounter slow, more resilient zombies during the wave that can revive and pursue players until the end of the wave).
[*] Free Supply (free gear bags become available in the main shop).
[*] Sell-Out (defense kits start having a discount).
[*] Taxes (defense kits start costing more).
[*] Leg Day (the player loses health and stamina when climbing).
[*] Hot-Tempered Bull (each Bull’s ground smash causes an explosion).
[*] My Chainsaw and Me (a random player gets an infinite ammo chainsaw without being able to use other weapons).
[*] Primary Weakness (primary weapon damage gets reduced by 75%).
[/list]
[/list]



[h1]General[/h1]

[list]
[*] Mutators from Horde Mode Challenge can now be used in private lobbies.
[*] Added Quick Match search option for Horde Mode and Horde Mode XL.
[*] Tokyo Horde Mode XL map is now available in the Horde Mode Challenge.
[*] Fixed a bug when the player with the "Judo" or "Rage Mode" perk could become invincible. 
[*] Fixed a bug when respawning a Vanguard class player with the "Stronger Together" perk would heal all players to full HP.
[*] Fixed a bug when the Grenade Launcher with the "Incendiary Grenades" weapon perk and "High Voltage" Slasher class perk could inflict unexpectedly high damage.
[*] Classes (Gunslinger, Fixer, Medic, Slasher) can now be assigned to the bots, and they can use the abilities of these classes.
[/list]


[h1]PC[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added the FSR 2.2 support.
[*] Added new DualSense Haptic Feedback effects.
[*] Fixed the Dead Sea Stroll level crashes on the MS Store game version.
[*] Consoles
[*] Added new DualSense Haptic Feedback effects on PlayStation 5.
[*] Fixed crashes in Horde Mode XL on PlayStation 5.
[*] Slightly improved performance on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5.
[/list]

notes.title: Free Booster Zombie Update is Live!
notes.content:
World War Z: AFTERMATH gets a free Halloween update today!

🧟 The new contagious BOOSTER zombie type added to all episodes
✔️ Daily Challenges for community rewards every day you play
📜 Rare Lore Documents to find and collect!

☢️ BOOSTER is armed with concentrated biosamples, it makes all zombies around it even more deadly. Spot Boosters in the swarm and take ‘em out quick!

New ✔️ Daily Challenges begin today! Survivors will have new opportunities to earn bonus in-game rewards every day with objectives like melee kill quotas, virus sample extraction, rare lore documents to collect, and much more.

[previewyoutube=VvLesr9MCnU;full][/previewyoutube]

Today's update also includes even more enhancements, optimizations and fixes - including further improvements to the new Vanguard class and more. Here are full patch notes:

NEW CONTENT
[list]
[*] Added new special enemy - Booster
[*] Added new daily challenges system
[*] Added new documents pickup that will spawn in daily and weekly challenges maps
[*] Collecting documents will unlock additional lore and level perks
[/list]

MELEE
[list]
[*] Melee attacks against prone and sitting zombies while wielding light melee weapons now deals the same damage as medium weapons
[/list]

VANGUARD
[list]
[*] Reworked block mechanic:
[/list]
o Block stamina (progress bar over the crosshair) is spent gradually each second you block. Full block stamina allows you to take any amount of hits for 5 seconds, no matter how many zombies attack you and how many are killed as a result.
o   Each time you spend block stamina, a small portion of equipment charge (progress bar over the equipment icon on the HUD) is also spent. Full block spends half of the charge. If you haven’t blocked incoming damage - you won’t spend any equipment charge.
o   You can activate the block even if you’re low on equipment charge, but you’ll also have less block stamina. If you don’t have any equipment charge left, you’ll only have stamina to block a single attack and won’t be able to use block for the next 5 seconds.
[list]
[*] Passive Aggression perk changed from:
[/list]
“Players can kill 40% more zombies with a Shield Block”
To:
“Shield Block can withstand incoming hits for 3 more seconds (base: 5 seconds)”
[list]
[*] Sturdy perk changed from:
[/list]
“When your Shield Block ends due to reaching your kill limit, you gain a temporary health boost”
To:
 “When your Shield Block is completely expended, you gain a temporary health boost”
[list]
[*] Quick Hands perk changed from:
[/list]
“Your primary and secondary weapons are reloaded after using a Shield”
To:
 “Blocking a zombie hit or performing Shield Charge reloads your primary and secondary weapons”
[list]
[*] Adrenaline Rush perk changed from:
[/list]
“Using a Shield fully restores melee stamina”
To:
 “Blocking a zombie hit or performing Shield Charge fully restores melee stamina”
[list]
[*] Long run perk: additional speed and distance bonus decreased to 20% from 30%
[*] Now Shield won’t protect you from deadly threats such as fans in the Jerusalem Episode


FIREARMS
[list]
[*] Explosive bolts fired from Repeater X crossbow will damage Rats as intended
[/list]

STABILITY
[list]
[*] Fixed freezes on next gen consoles
[*] Various fixes and improvements
[*] Fixed several gameplay crashes
[*] Fixed issue with not being able to control character movement speed when using controller
[/list]

PC SPECIFIC
[list]
[*] Added option to rebind scoreboard to another button
[*] Added Steam Input support 
[/list]
